questions.q:
Observe the following chemical reaction:

$$\text{H}_2\text{S} + \text{I}_2 \rightarrow 2\text{HI} + \text{S}$$

Which of the following statements correctly describes this redox reaction?

**Statements:**
I: Hydrogen sulphide undergoes oxidation to form sulphur.
II: Iodine is reduced, producing hydrogen iodide.
options: Both Statement I and II are correct
Both Statement I and II are incorrect
questions.explain: In this reaction, $\text{H}_2\text{S}$ loses hydrogen (oxidation) to become Sulphur (S). Meanwhile, $\text{I}_2$ gains hydrogen (reduction) to form Hydrogen Iodide (HI). Therefore, both statements correctly describe the redox process.

questions.q: What type of reaction occurs when barium chloride reacts with sodium sulfate?
questions.explain: The reaction is: $\text{BaCl}_2(aq) + \text{Na}_2\text{SO}_4(aq) \rightarrow \text{BaSO}_4(s) + 2\text{NaCl}(aq)$. The ions mutually exchange places, making it a double displacement (and precipitation) reaction.
